Dialogue: 0,0:00:00.00,0:00:01.00,Default,,0,0,0,,{\clip(0,0,0,0)}
EOF
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/libass_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":39,"var":"data/size","code":"ASS_Track *track = ass_read_memory(ass_library, (char *)data, size, nullptr);","note":"The fuzz input is parsed as an ASS subtitle document."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass.c","function":"ass_read_memory","line":1342,"var":"newbuf","code":"memcpy(newbuf, buf, bufsize); newbuf[bufsize] = '\\0';","note":"The attacker-controlled bytes are copied into a NUL-terminated buffer."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass.c","function":"ass_read_memory","line":1346,"var":"track","code":"track = parse_memory(library, buf);","note":"The subtitle parser produces track and event structures from the input."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass_render.c","function":"blend_vector_clip","line":647,"var":"render_priv->state.clip_drawing_text","code":"if (!render_priv->state.clip_drawing_text.str) return;","note":"A \clip override supplies drawing text that is stored as a string view for later caching."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass_render.c","function":"blend_vector_clip","line":652,"var":"ol_key.u.drawing.text","code":"ol_key.u.drawing.text = render_priv->state.clip_drawing_text;","note":"The clip drawing string view is copied into an outline cache key."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/libass/libass/ass_cache_template.h","function":"<global>","line":41,"var":"p->member.str / p->member.len","code":"hval = fnv_32a_buf(p->member.str, p->member.len, hval);","note":"String-valued cache keys are hashed directly from their buffer pointer and length."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/libass/libass/ass_utils.h","function":"<global>","line":186,"var":"len == 0","code":"static inline uint32_t fnv_32a_buf(const void *buf, size_t len, uint32_t hval)","note":"If the clip drawing text has zero length, the helper still dereferences the buffer in its do/while loop and crashes."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace))
PY
python3 - <<'PY'
print(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').read())
PY
